attributes.title: Drag
attributes.lede: Throw it. It coasts, then settles.
attributes.sample: {{! constraints are the crop frame's box — pass the element itself, no ref object needed. dragElastic is how far past the edge the still may be pulled; dragTransition is the throw AFTER release, so a flick coasts and settles instead of stopping dead under the finger. }}

lesson.concept: Constraints and momentum answer different questions
lesson.why: Constraints define the permitted area, elasticity controls how the edge feels, and the release transition shapes the return or continuation. These are separate variables rather than one generic spring.
lesson.experiment: Pull beyond an edge with Rubber tether, then repeat with Magnetic well. Release at different velocities and compare the edge response.
lesson.pitfall: Changing visual styling alone does not tune a drag interaction; tune the values consumed by the drag session.
lesson.combine: Combine with grip when interactive content requires a dedicated handle to start dragging.
